---
applyTo: "README.md,CHANGELOG.md,docs/**,release-metadata.json"
---

Follow `AGENTS.md` (canonical sources and claims).

`docs/claims-registry.json` governs public claims. Source catalog is `docs/supported-actions.md`; published-package facts are `landing/lib/published-release.json`. Do not mix those scopes. Automated tests are not licensed-host verification. Do not invent Marketplace status, testimonials, rankings, or host results. When changing a version, search package, lockfile, CEP/UXP manifests, marketplace, MCP config, updater, landing, and installers together.
